name: Cheech & Chong - Eighth - StaDankOhhh
description:
Indoor-grown, hand-trimmed, top-shelf. The Cheech & Chong StaDankOhhh eighth delivers 3.5 grams of premium indoor flower — dense, frosty, and cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

StaDankOhhh earns the name: loud, pungent, and unmistakably dank. Expect sharp gas and skunky funk up front, layered with deep earthy notes, a peppery edge, and a smooth, resinous finish. Dense, trichome-caked buds with a nose that announces itself the second the jar cracks open.

Why you'll love it:

3.5G premium indoor flower — grown in a controlled environment for consistent quality
Hand-trimmed and properly cured — dense, frosty buds with a smooth, even burn
Signature StaDankOhhh flavor — sharp gas and skunky funk with deep earth and pepper
Full terpene expression — rich aroma and flavor straight from the jar
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Premium flower, real flavor, and top-shelf quality in every eighth. Cheech & Chong StaDankOhhh is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
